sources.entry: KeePassXC - Cross-platform community-driven port of the Windows application "Keepass Password Safe"

summary.one_liner: KeePassXC is a cross-platform, open-source password manager that stores logins, notes and other sensitive data in an offline encrypted KDBX database file.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes KeePassXC as a password manager for Windows, macOS, and Linux that saves usernames, passwords, URLs, attachments, and notes in an encrypted file that can be kept in any location, including cloud storage. Entries can have custom titles and icons and are sorted into groups, and an integrated search supports advanced patterns. It includes a password generator that can produce random passwords or passphrases, plus TOTP storage and generation. Browser integration is listed for Chrome, Firefox, Edge, Chromium, Vivaldi, Brave, and Tor Browser, with passkey support through that integration. Advanced features include database reports, CSV/XML/HTML export, keepassxc-cli, SSH Agent integration, and a FreeDesktop Secret Service implementation.
use_cases: import passwords from other password managers
manage passwords from the command line
how_to_run: Download pre-compiled binaries from the project's downloads page
Or install from your Linux distribution's package list if available
See the QuickStart Guide and User Guide for first-run instructions
See the Build and Install page or the Wiki to build from source
notable: Browser integration with multiple browsers, including passkey support
KDBX database format compatible with KeePass (KDBX3 and KDBX4)
Command line interface (keepassxc-cli) and SSH Agent integration
Import from 1Password, Bitwarden, Proton Pass, CSV and KeePass1; export to CSV, XML, HTML
Offline encrypted database that can be stored in any location
caveats: README does not state pricing or paid tiers
Building from source requires the instructions on the separate Build and Install page or Wiki
